$Comment: Supper for Tomas, one of the three supper deliveries that close Martha's questline: once The Feast is
collected, Martha sends a plate of the leftovers to each villager who helped all week, and one line of
hers (deliveries_offer in her conversation) takes all three. The _Harvest_Feast folder makes the id
harvest_feast_supper_tomas; Supper_Elsie.json and Supper_Bram.json are its two siblings. The Feast's
pay hands over the leftovers they ask for (Lootables/SeasonsOfOrbis/Harvest_Feast_Feast_Pay.json); a
player without them bakes or cooks their own.
Martha gives it (the base's Npc), and its one step is handed in at Tomas: TurnInNpcId names his role,
the id his placement stands him under (NpcPlacements/Harvest_Feast_Miller_Temple.json), kept standing
with KeepAlive, Respawn and Fortify. Each delivery is a quest of its own so that a hand-in at the
villager finishes it, which is what lets his conversation open on his thanks (its Ready row) the
moment the player arrives with the plate. CompletionDialogue is his conversation, since the pay is
collected at him and the conversation that follows is his, not Martha's.
Repeat.PerRun brings it back once in each year's run of Harvest Feast, the way The Feast comes back.
Requires reads The Feast as collected, which stays true from the first year on; Martha's offer line
waits for this year's Feast all the same, since it reads The Feast's own state.
The Mmo_Xp row is MMO Skill Tree's: Crafting XP, as the cooking quests pay, waiting to be collected
with the rest. The row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server
without that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the rest of the quest pays.
Name: Supper_Tomas
